request.subject: CITY:1

layers.text: Add one small plain pennant flag in solid bright red (#d8262c) on a short pole at the tip of the tower roof, flying to the right, about twelve pixels long. Nothing else is bright red. Keep the tower, the cottages, the colours, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the buildings.
